hints: Track 3 states per cell during DFS evaluation: unvisited, visiting (active recursion stack), and visited (memoized integer result).
Whenever DFS reaches a cell currently marked visiting, immediately raise ValueError("Circular reference").
Parse each formula string after "=" via recursive descent (expr + / -, term * / /, factor number / cell / unary / parentheses) using int(a / b) truncation.
